whyProfessional.title: Why Professional Dryclean Care for Sweaters?
whyProfessional.subtitle: Knitted fabrics are loops of yarn, and heat plus agitation lock them together into felt. Here is why professional dryclean care is the safer choice for winter wear:

points.title: No Shrinking
points.desc: No hot wash and no tumble dryer — the two things that shrink wool.

points.title: No Felting
points.desc: A gentle solvent cycle keeps fibres from matting into a stiff, felted surface.

points.title: Shape Restored
points.desc: Each piece is blocked back to its size, so cuffs, hems and necklines do not flare.

points.title: Softness Kept
points.desc: Natural oils in wool are not stripped the way detergent strips them.

points.title: Less Pilling
points.desc: Low friction means fewer bobbles on sleeves and sides.

points.title: Stored Folded
points.desc: Returned folded flat, because a hanger stretches knitwear out of shape.
